Bug_Title: DMI: Bad constant value for month (DMI_BAD_MONTH)
Bug_Details:
This code passes a constant month
value outside the expected range of 0..11 to a method.
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded in the generated code by passing an invalid month value of 12 to the Calendar.set method. The valid range for months in the Calendar class is 0 (January) to 11 (December).
Trigger_Explanation: The test calls the showBug method of the MonthBugDemo class, which sets an invalid month value of 12. This triggers the bug because the valid range for months in the Calendar class is 0 (January) to 11 (December). The test then asserts that the result is 12, which causes the test to fail.
